answers.core: Curve is a core Resource. This enhancement would increase its flexibility to be more easily applied in a wider range of cases without sacrificing any of its current functions.
answers.workaround: Yes. Applying a `inverse_lerp(min, max, value)` where `value` is **X** and `min/max` are the range's min/max limits, respectively, normalizes X to a 0/1 ratio, which can then be sampled on the Curve to obtain the value of **Y**.

title: In Curve resource: @export Min/Max X values to the Inspector
